title: GhcResult
description: Schema document to format in Json the timetable created by PenalaraGHC.

weight.title: ResultWeight
weight.description: Weight of the result according to the non-mandatory conditions not fulfilled.

anonymousClassRooms.title: SetOfAnonymousClassRooms
anonymousClassRooms.description: Collection with anonymous classrooms created by the engine. The classrooms are grouped by set of classrooms.

items.title: AnonymousClassRoom
items.description: Object with anonymous classrooms created in a set of classrooms.

classRoomsCreated.title: ListOfAnonymousRooms
classRoomsCreated.description: List of anonymous classroom created in one set of classrooms.

assignedSections.title: AssignedSections
assignedSections.description: List of sections assigned in the Timetable.

items.title: AssignedSection
items.description: Section with one class units (or on call hours) assigned.

day.description: Day of the week when the section is located.

realIndex.description: Position on the day, of the real section, in the frame.

fictionalIndex.description: Position on the day, of the fictional section, in the frame.
fictionalIndex.$comment: The engine make the fictional sections, as a division of Real Sections.

startTime.description: Start time of the section with a fictional index where sessions are assigned

endTime.description: End time of the section with a fictional index where sessions are assigned.

assignment.title: Assignment
assignment.description: Object with list of each type of session can be assigned in the section (teaching session, meetings, complementary activities, on call services).

teachingSessions.title: TeachingSessions
teachingSessions.description: List of teaching sessions assigned in the section.

items.title: AssignedTeachingSession
items.description: Class unit or on call hour assigned in the timetable.

refSession.description: Identifier of the teaching session assigned.

refTeachers.title: RefTeachers
refTeachers.description: Optional. List of teachers assigned to the class unit. If the field is not informed, the teachers configured in the session are taken. The first is always the main teacher. It is used only in the case that alternative teachers have been configured.

items.title: RefTeacher
items.description: Identifier of the teacher in the input file.

refContinuosBlock.description: Optional. For fixed distribution entities, a common reference is created for the allocation information of the entities that have been placed together in a block due to the temporality of their distribution.

meetings.title: AssignedMeetings
meetings.description: List of meetings assigned in the section.

items.title: AssignedMeeting
items.description: Meeting of teachers assigned in the timetable.

refContinuosBlock.description: Optional. For fixed distribution entities, a common reference is created for the allocation information of the entities that have been placed together in a block due to the temporality of their distribution.

complementaryActivities.title: ComplementaryActivitiesAssigned
complementaryActivities.description: List of meetings assigned in the section.

items.title: AssignedComplementary
items.description: Teacher's complementary activity assigned in the timetable.

refComplementary.description: Identifier of the Complementary Activity assigned.

refContinuosBlock.description: Optional. For fixed distribution entities, a common reference is created for the allocation information of the entities that have been placed together in a block due to the temporality of their distribution.

onCallServices.title: OnCallServices
onCallServices.description: List of teaching on call hours assigned in the section.

items.title: AssignedOnCallService
items.description: Call hour assigned in the timetable.

refOnCall.description: Identifier of the teaching session assigned.

refTeacher.title: RefTeachers
refTeacher.description: Teacher assigned in section on call service.

refClassRomms.title: RefclassRomms
refClassRomms.description: List of classrooms assigned to teach the class unit.

items.title: RefclassRomm
items.description: Identifier of the classroom in the input file.
